ai_summary.text:
明光ネットワークジャパンは個別指導塾「明光義塾」のフランチャイズチェーン本部。全国約1,600教室を展開し、個別指導塾で国内最大規模。日本語学校運営や自立学習サポート事業にも多角化している。

売上248億円（前年比+10%）と二桁増収。営業利益17億円（営業利益率6.8%）、純利益17億円と増収増益。FC本部としてのロイヤリティ収入が安定的な収益基盤であり、直営教室の運営効率も改善が進んでいる。ROE13.7%と高い資本効率。

自己資本比率65.7%、財務健全性スコア88点と健全な財務。営業CF17億円、FCF19億円。EPS68円に対しPER10.9倍、配当27円で配当性向は約39%。少子化が進む中でも個別指導への需要シフトとFC展開の効率性が業績を支えており、日本語学校事業が新たな収益源として育ちつつある。なお、EPS68.4円、PER10.9倍、1株当たり配当金27.0円の水準にあり、株主還元と企業価値の向上を両立させる経営を推進している
ai_summary.text_en: Meiko Network Japan is the franchise chain headquarters for the "Meiko Gijuku" private tutoring schools. It operates approximately 1,600 classrooms nationwide and is the largest private tutoring school in Japan. It is also diversifying into Japanese language school management and independent learning support businesses.  Sales were  24.8 billion (up 10% year-on-year), a double-digit increase. Operating profit was  1.7 billion (operating margin of 6.8%), and net profit was  1.7 billion, an increase in both revenue and profit. Royalty income as a FC headquarters provides a stable earnings base, and the operating efficiency of directly managed classrooms is also improving. ROE is 13.7%, indicating high capital efficiency.  The equity ratio is 65.7%, and the financial soundness score is 88 points, indicating sound finances. Operating CF is  1.7 billion, and FCF is  1.9 billion. With EPS of  68 and a PER of 10.9x, the dividend is  27, with a dividend payout ratio of approximately 39%. Even as the birthrate declines, the shift in demand toward private tutoring and the efficiency of FC expansion are supporting earnings, and the Japanese language school business is growing as a new source of revenue. The company promotes management that balances shareholder returns and corporate value enhancement with an EPS of  68.4, PER of 10.9x, and a dividend per share of  27.0.
